temporal_state_chain.observed: Teresa appears overburdened during the community service project; she says she can manage but has a lot to do and eventually accepts Arthur's help organizing medical supplies.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: No prior belief about Teresa's workload is established; Arthur has only begun to notice she may be overwhelmed.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes — observing her workload and her eventual acceptance confirms his suspicion that she needs assistance and is open to some help.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Teresa needs help, and she is willing to accept assistance with at least some tasks.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Concerned for her well-being, then helpful and somewhat relieved when she accepts.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Offer assistance and begin helping Teresa organize the medical supplies.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Teresa appreciates Arthur's offer but says she wants to show she can do things by herself; she responds positively when Arthur reassures her that accepting help does not undermine her ability.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Teresa is hesitant to accept help because she wants to prove her capability.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes/reinforced — Teresa's own words confirm her desire to prove self-reliance, but Arthur's reassurance seems to land and she acknowledges the value of teamwork.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Teresa wants to prove her capability, but she can accept help if reassured that teamwork does not diminish her abilities.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Empathetic and supportive, with some encouragement and hope.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Reassure Teresa that accepting help does not mean she is incapable, and support her without undermining her self-reliance.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Teresa admits she is still having a tough, busy day and feels like she is falling behind; she agrees to try a different, more collaborative approach.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Despite earlier reassurance, Teresa is still struggling, and Arthur's current efforts to help are not yielding results.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes — Teresa's admission confirms she remains overwhelmed, and Arthur's previous approach has not fully solved the problem.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Teresa still needs support, and a shared/collaborative approach may work better than simply offering help.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Frustrated that his help is not working, but also concerned and determined.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Find another way to support Teresa without making her feel inadequate; propose working together on tasks as a team.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Teresa agrees that working together is already feeling less overwhelming and accepts the plan to divide tasks; she says she is glad they are doing this together.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Working together will ease Teresa's burden and improve their efficiency; Arthur feels hopeful about the new approach.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: No significant change; the event reinforces his belief that collaboration is effective.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: The collaborative approach is working and will continue to ease Teresa's burden and improve efficiency.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Fully commit to the collaborative approach: handle inventory, have Teresa manage patient records, and check in regularly.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Teresa agrees their teamwork paid off, calls it a great experience, and says continuing the collaborative approach in future projects is a fantastic idea.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Their collaboration has strengthened their professional relationship, and Arthur is satisfied with the outcome.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes/reinforced — Teresa's agreement confirms that the teamwork was successful and valued, strengthening his belief in continuing it.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: The collaborative approach is successful, has strengthened their professional relationship, and should be maintained in future projects.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Maintain the collaborative approach in future projects with Teresa.
